# Azamat Jauysh (Азамат Жауыш) — Full-Cycle AI Product & Infrastructure Architect

> Official engineering portfolio and B2B software catalog of Azamat Jauysh (https://niaz.kz). End-to-end architect of commercial neuro-symbolic GovTech & agentic EdTech SaaS platforms, a centralized 9-module K-12 Student Information System (SIS), and carrier-grade multi-campus SD-WAN & Proxmox cloud infrastructure across 8 institutional units (7 campuses + HQ).

## Key Impact Metrics
- **8 Institutional Units (7 Campuses + HQ)**: Unified K-12 Digital OS powered by PostgreSQL 16 Core SIS, MikroTik WireGuard SD-WAN, and Proxmox VE (CT 100–107).
- **3,500+ Active Production Users**: 2,978 students, 582 synced IAM staff profiles, 50+ executives, and 700+ peak concurrent Olympiad users.
- **41x Systems Speedup**: Custom Python + SQLite WAL daemons (~12 MB RAM, 23.6 ms TTFB), 13.3 ms HR/IAM APIs, and 0.005s GovTech AI caching.
- **100 TB+ Enterprise Cloud**: Google Workspace Enterprise IAM lifecycle automation, 5-Layer DMZ security, and chattr +i root-immutable backups.
- **13 Production Systems**: Structured into 3 Flagship Ecosystems (GovTech AI, Agentic EdTech AI, and 8-Campus K-12 Digital OS) plus ERP & Consumer PWAs.

## 13 Production Systems & Internal Case Studies
1. **Auto-Tender GovTech AI** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/auto-tender`) — 5 procurement portals, 4-Layer Neuro-Symbolic AI Spec/Price Verifier (temp=0.0 Gemini Judge + Reflexion loop), 5-Layer AntiBanGuard (0.005s cache), 6–12 mo Pre-RFP forecast, and retail/1688/OEM customs margin graph (411+ winners CRM).
2. **OmniCheck Agentic AI** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/omnicheck`) — Multi-tenant STEM homework grading & autonomous pedagogical loop (Concept Gap → Mastery Recovery → Morning Warm-up → Compassionate Briefing) across 4 Workspace Modes, with client-side HTML5 Canvas Top-7% GDPR Privacy Shield and <1s 64-bit dHash check.
3. **Core K-12 SIS & API Gateway** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/core-sis`) — PostgreSQL 16 Single Source of Truth consolidating 481 legacy forms (72 doc groups) into 9 normalized schemas across 8 units, with strict Google SSO RBAC, 24h auto-suspend IAM, and 4-language A4 official document generation.
4. **LuminaMath Olympiad Engine** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/luminamath`) — High-concurrency national math competition platform on Google Cloud Run (1,200 concurrent request capacity), atomic 6-digit IDs, and stateless PostgreSQL BYTEA OMR PDF streaming (<1 ms lookup).
5. **EduStaff HR, Olympiad Registry & Workspace IAM** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/hr-orizont`) — 582 synced staff IAM records, 239 public faculty portfolios, 1-click Google Workspace offboarding, 1996–2026 Olympiad Medal Registry with QR-verified A4 diplomas, and 13.3 ms TTFB GDPR APIs.
6. **GM-App Admissions MIS & CRM** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/gm-app`) — Replaces 30-sheet Excel workbooks across 7 campuses for 50+ executives with a 13-column live quota matrix, 5-stage exam funnel, and 321-school outreach CRM.
7. **SSP Elective Engine** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/ssp`) — 3-stage high-school curriculum scheduler enforcing REAL/UMANIST track rules via PostgreSQL Serializable isolation (0% seat overbooking) and live Socket.IO quota bars.
8. **Multi-Campus Corporate Portal & 3D-Secure CMS** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/corporate-web-cms`) — 30-route trilingual Next.js SSG + hardened PHP 8.4 CMS Bridge replacing a 4.1 GB WordPress setup, with live bank 3D-Secure tuition acquiring, 4-tranche calculator, and 2,773 GDPR-filtered alumni records.
9. **5-Agent AI Media OS** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/media-os`) — Zero-Password hub governing 29 social channels across 7 branches + HQ with a 5-Agent AI Marketing Pipeline, 1-click photo enhance, AI video SRT subtitles, Competitor Ad Spy, and Social-to-Lead CRM.
10. **CampusCast Smart TV Signage** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/smart-tv-signage`) — Centralized Python + SQLite WAL digital signage engine broadcasting announcements, olympiad champions, birthdays, and 310 calendar milestones across 7 campuses over WireGuard SD-WAN ($0 per-screen fee).
11. **Multi-Campus WireGuard SD-WAN & 12MB NOC** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/school-it-infra`) — MikroTik CRS418/RB4011 SD-WAN (~7ms RTT), 65+ CAPsMAN Wi-Fi 6 APs, Proxmox VE (CT 100–107), 5-Layer DMZ, 12 MB RAM Helpdesk/NOC (41x faster TTFB), Ansible DR, and chattr +i backups.
12. **«Береке» Family PWA** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/my-family`) — Offline-first family wellness PWA with 30–120 min Digital Detox timer, guided evening parent-child bonding prompts, Gemini AI screen-time analytics, Supabase Realtime sync, and nightly Telegram digests.
13. **1C:Enterprise 8.3 Linux Cluster** (`https://niaz.kz/en/projects/1c-enterprise`) — 64-bit Ubuntu + Postgres Pro 1C v16 server cluster (CT 105) maintained via 1C:EDT + Git XML source decomposition and REST/JSON web bridges.
